name: MemHub Universal Memory
description: Shared local memory with per-turn conversation capture, previous-session restore, independent optional summaries, and memory/session tools. Requires bundled core for automatic conversation capture.
safetyNotes: Reads and writes local memory and redacted conversation journals (~/.memory and <project>/.memory). Sessions are excluded from Git and are never automatically deleted. After each completed run, queues one memory self-check message for the same agent (disable with selfCheck.enabled=false or MEMHUB_SELF_CHECK=0); that run is excluded from saved journals. Optional model endpoints use config.json rerank/summary sections or MEMHUB_RERANK_* / MEMHUB_SUMMARY_*; summary calls send redacted dialogue to the separately configured endpoint. Physical deletion requires confirm=true.

agentTools.name: search
agentTools.description: Search global and project memories by query. Returns IDs, scopes, titles, and one-line summaries (no bodies).

cwd.description: Verified absolute path to the target project. Defaults to the session workspace; set this to read another project's .memory.

agentTools.name: load
agentTools.description: Load full Markdown content of one memory entry by exact ID and update last_access.

cwd.description: Verified absolute path to the target project. Defaults to the session workspace.

agentTools.name: propose
agentTools.description: Pass an items array to save durable memory or update a handoff. Current project stage, latest progress, TODOs and PR state belong in scope="handoff", task="project-status", not global long-term memory. Set cwd to the verified target project even when this session is in a different workspace; use separate calls for different projects. Same task updates in place. paths only controls retrieval. Long-term: only durable lessons grounded in user messages or tool output; same title supersedes the old conclusion. Commits directly unless requireReview is true.

cwd.description: Verified absolute path to the project whose .memory should receive these items. Defaults to the session workspace. Do not use global scope as a substitute for targeting another project.

requireReview.description: Optional: queue to inbox instead of committing immediately.

title.description: State the conclusion itself, e.g. "生产镜像必须指定 linux/amd64".

summary.description: One line: when / under which conditions it applies.

content.description: Full text. Handoffs: 目标 / 当前进度 / 验收标准 / 下一步 / 阻塞 / 相关文件. Record stage-only updates too; mark missing details 未提供 rather than inventing them.

triggers.description: Situations and synonyms that should recall this memory (e.g. 上线, 部署, docker build).

paths.description: Optional project-relative globs for retrieval only (e.g. packages/daemon/**). Does not select the write destination; use cwd for that.

scope.description: global: durable knowledge valid across projects. project: durable knowledge for the target repo. handoff: changing project stage, latest progress, TODOs or task state.

task.description: Handoff only: fixed key; use project-status for the project's current stage, and a distinct stable key for each concrete task. Same key updates in place.

status.description: Handoff only. done requires every acceptance item checked with evidence.

ttl_days.description: Handoff only: expire after N days without update (default 14).

agentTools.name: forget
agentTools.description: Deprecate or archive an existing memory entry autonomously, or physically delete with confirm=true after explicit user approval.

cwd.description: Verified absolute path to the target project. Defaults to the session workspace.

confirm.description: Required true only for irreversible mode="delete".

agentTools.name: session_list
agentTools.description: List saved conversation sources. Defaults to this workspace; cross_workspace explicitly discovers other projects.

agentTools.name: session_load
agentTools.description: Read saved original messages by sequence. Use workspace_root from session_list for another workspace; summaries are not verbatim quotes.

agentTools.name: session_status
agentTools.description: Inspect saved sequence, summary coverage, restoration source and location-index health. Host hook trust is not verified by core.

agentTools.name: session_restore
agentTools.description: Restore and pin the previous main conversation in this workspace, independent of source agent.

agentTools.name: session_capture
agentTools.description: Save standardized dialogue independently of long-term memory. Supply stable message_key values; never submit hidden reasoning.
